Added parenthetical clarifying that the label is topological (sign structure), not a claim about 1/r² spatial form. The ∇·B=0 argument depends only on sign structure. Curmudgeon c12 H0 optional minor.

tldr_evidence: All 6 fixes are minor text precision improvements: clarifying which file contains specific values (ISS-2771), adding a second equation to a structural argument (ISS-2773), tightening a citation attribution to match the papers' actual temporal scope (ISS-2774), adding a cross-WIN-consistent relative-error label (ISS-2777), inserting one missing sentence into a charitable-reading rebuttal (ISS-2779), and disambiguating a topological label from a spatial-form claim (ISS-2784). No verdicts change; no attack surface is opened.
